inheritedFrom.note: GATE22 canonical prior authority already fixes the GATE25 ordering rule. This mandate restates and hardens it; it does not create it.

selectionBoundary.statement: Analogue selection is a strictly two-phase transformation. Phase 1 selects. Phase 2 attaches. GATE22 Outcome may never participate in phase 1, in any form.

phases.name: SELECTION
admissibleInputs: bound GATE23 FeatureRecord(T), referenced through a FeatureVectorBindingId
bound GATE24 RegimeRecord(T), referenced through its RegimeRecordId with an explicitly bound RegimeHorizonSpecId
eligible historical identities from GATE21, within the ratified eligible-history pin set
phases.admissibilityRule: Every phase 1 input must carry its own proof that availableAt <= the applicable cutoff.
phases.completionMeaning: The analogue set and every per-analogue distance are computed, content-addressed and frozen.

phases.name: OUTCOME_ATTACHMENT
phases.precondition: selectionComplete is true and the analogue set identity is frozen
permitted: attachment of GATE22 Outcome to already-selected analogues
reporting an outcome distribution over the frozen analogue set with an explicit outcome horizon binding
forbidden: any other change to the analogue set once an Outcome is visible

outcomeProhibitionInSelection.forbiddenAsSelectionInput: GATE22 Outcome, OutcomeId, OutcomeStatus, OutcomeMissingReason, OutcomeWindowCause, DatasetId_outcome and any label derived from them
forms: embedded in a threshold, weight or ranking rule
outcomeProhibitionInSelection.rule: An outcome-conditioned change to the analogue set is a leakage defect, not a refinement.

selectionBoundary.bypassProhibition: No raw historical access that bypasses the declared input boundaries is admissible, and no phase 2 artifact may feed back into phase 1.

dependencyBinding.rule: GATE25 consumes GATE24 RegimeRecords as an upstream producer only. GATE25 does not reopen, reinterpret, extend or modify any GATE24 artifact, identity, invariant or Owner decision.

gate23Relation.rule: GATE25 consumes GATE23 FeatureRecords read-only through a FeatureVectorBindingId. GATE25 defines no feature, no window and no formula.

gate22Relation.rule: GATE25 consumes GATE22 Outcome read-only and only after selectionComplete. GATE25 produces no Outcome and defines no horizon, formula, taxonomy or price basis.
gate22Relation.horizonAuthorityRule: The Outcome window (T, T+H] and the admissible H values are owned by GATE22 and are consumed, never redefined.

gate21Relation.rule: GATE25 consumes GATE21 v1 historical identities read-only for eligible history, and consumes GATE21 transitively through GATE23 and GATE24. GATE25 does not reopen GATE21 and performs no history-source expansion.
gate21Relation.evidenceValue: G25 analogs are declared out of scope for GATE21; GATE21 supplies historical identities and never analogue semantics
gate21Relation.evolvabilityRule: GATE21 evolvability is ADDITIVE_VERSIONED with deprecation BY_VERSION_ID_NEVER_SILENT_REWRITE; GATE25 consumption must respect it.

classes.expectation: A versioned, deterministic policy declaring the bound similarity dimensions, the distance metric, the eligibility rule and the selection rule, under an explicit selection policy version identity.

A content-addressed analogue identity under an EXACT_ONLY closure rule, identifying the question asked and never the answer, with resolved distances, rankings, outcomes and uncertainty states excluded from the digest.
An append-only store keyed by the analogue identity, idempotent on identical replay, refusing divergent replay under the same key, and never rewritten by a later vintage or restatement.
Per analogue, the reproducible distance, the common factors and the differences, attributable to the explicitly bound dimensions that produced them.
Explicit sample size, eligible universe, exclusions with reasons, and a declared uncertainty state. Insufficient support is reported as insufficiency and never promoted into confidence.
A distribution over GATE22 Outcomes attached to the already-frozen analogue set, carrying an explicit outcome horizon binding and proof that attachment followed selectionComplete.
A downstream consumption boundary declaring what GATE25 produces, what a consumer must bind explicitly, and that a GATE25 PASS is not a GATE26 authorization.
Evidence that analogue computation is off-scan, performs no network access, is not recomputed per ticker, and measures a zero live scan latency delta.

Complete provenance per analogue including selected historical snapshot hashes, distance calculations, eligible universe and exclusions, plus an independent replay reproducing an identical analogue set.

validationExpectations.name: CAUSAL SELECTION
validationExpectations.expectation: Every selection input at T carries a proof that availableAt <= K(T), and every historical candidate is read at its own cutoff.

validationExpectations.name: OUTCOME LEAKAGE HOSTILE
validationExpectations.expectation: An Outcome offered to phase 1 is rejected in every declared form: direct, lagged, renamed, type-laundered, aggregated into a statistic, embedded in a threshold or rule, or derived from a future outcome.

validationExpectations.name: POST-SELECTION ATTACHMENT ORDER
validationExpectations.expectation: Attachment is admissible only after selectionComplete, and any change to the analogue set after an Outcome becomes visible is refused.

validationExpectations.name: DISTANCE REPRODUCIBILITY
validationExpectations.expectation: Every per-analogue distance recomputes to the identical value from the bound inputs and the declared policy version.

validationExpectations.name: EXACT REPLAY
validationExpectations.expectation: Identical bytes and versions reproduce an identical analogue set in identical order, including identical identities.

validationExpectations.name: SAMPLE SIZE EXPLICIT
validationExpectations.expectation: Sample size, eligible universe and exclusions with reasons are present and arithmetically consistent for every emitted analogue set.

validationExpectations.name: INSUFFICIENT SUPPORT NOT PROMOTED
validationExpectations.expectation: An analogue set below the ratified sufficiency rule is emitted as insufficient and is never converted into a confidence, a score or a silently narrower comparison.

validationExpectations.name: HORIZON BINDING EXPLICIT
validationExpectations.expectation: The regime horizon and the outcome horizon are both bound explicitly, and no implicit fallback to a default, the first available or the most recent is admissible.

validationExpectations.name: REGIME DEPENDENCE EXPLICIT
validationExpectations.expectation: The regime dimensions that conditioned a selection are individually recorded and independently readable in the provenance.

validationExpectations.name: NO COMPOSITE LABEL MATCHING
validationExpectations.expectation: A selection driven only by a composite or concatenated regime label is refused; explicit dimension binding is required.

validationExpectations.name: ELIGIBLE UNIVERSE COMPLETENESS
validationExpectations.expectation: The eligible universe accounts for every candidate considered, with each exclusion carrying an explicit reason and no unexplained gap.

validationExpectations.name: VINTAGE LEAKAGE HOSTILE
validationExpectations.expectation: A later revision cannot contaminate an older historical candidate; replay uses the vintage available at that candidate's own cutoff.

validationExpectations.name: NO SILENT FALLBACK
validationExpectations.expectation: A missing, ambiguous or non-single-valued binding fails closed with an explicit reason and never falls back to a default, a neighbouring value or a wider universe.

validationExpectations.name: NETWORK OFF DURING COMPUTATION
validationExpectations.expectation: Analogue computation performs no network access, and no request occurs on the Wheel live scan path or per ticker.

validationExpectations.name: LIVE SCAN PERFORMANCE NON-REGRESSION
validationExpectations.expectation: The Wheel live scan critical path measures a zero latency delta with GATE25 present.

validationExpectations.name: PROVENANCE COMPLETENESS
validationExpectations.expectation: Every analogue traces to its selected historical snapshot hashes, its distance calculation and its bound identities; no opaque analogue is emitted.

validationExpectations.name: POLICY VERSION MUTATION
validationExpectations.expectation: Any change to the similarity dimension set, the metric, the eligibility rule or the sufficiency rule produces a new version and a new identity; historical analogue records are never rewritten.

validationExpectations.name: DEFERRED CAPABILITY NON-PARTICIPATION
validationExpectations.expectation: No GATE24 registered-inactive dimension and no GATE24 deferred capability participates in selection, and none is silently promoted by a GATE25 need.

validationExpectations.name: CALENDAR REUSE
validationExpectations.expectation: calendarWindowBindingId is resolved by reference from the bound GATE23 FeatureSet, fails closed when not single-valued, and no CalendarWindowBinding is constructed by GATE25.

validationExpectations.name: UPSTREAM NON-MUTATION
validationExpectations.expectation: A GATE25 run leaves every GATE21, GATE22, GATE23, GATE24, GEE and Directional Lab artifact byte-identical.

closedOwnerDecisions.subject: similarity dimension subset
closedOwnerDecisions.question: Which subset of the available bound inputs constitutes the similarity dimensions used for selection, and how are feature dimensions and GATE24 CORE_V1 regime dimensions combined?
closedOwnerDecisions.preservedFrom: Prior Owner acceptance after GATE25 OD-1 volatilityState repair. Substance unchanged by this amendment.
closedOwnerDecisions.resolution: GATE25 V1 regime eligibility is exact-match of the six CORE_V1 dimensions: primaryMarketRegime, volatilityState, inflationState, ratesState, yieldCurveShape, yieldCurveDirection. volatilityState is read only as a sealed RegimeVector member. GATE25 does not recompute volatility and does not consume F2_REALIZED_VOLATILITY. A fail-closed volatilityState is handled by the already-accepted missing-data rule, not by removing the dimension. Numeric similarity remains F1_SIMPLE_RETURN@W5 and F1_SIMPLE_RETURN@W21 only, same InstrumentIdentityId, RegimeHorizonSpecId sessionCount=21. Inactive GATE24 dimensions, F2/F3/F4, non-core F1 windows, cross-section, Outcome and composite-regime-label matching remain excluded.

closedOwnerDecisions.subject: distance metric family
closedOwnerDecisions.question: Which distance metric family governs analogue comparison, and how are heterogeneous dimensions made commensurable without inventing weights?
closedOwnerDecisions.preservedFrom: Prior Owner acceptance of the GATE25 Owner-decision closure review. Substance unchanged by this amendment.
closedOwnerDecisions.resolution: V1 distance family is Manhattan L1 on (F1@W5, F1@W21) after deterministic per-dimension min-max normalization over the frozen eligible universe at T, after exact regime eligibility. Cosine, Mahalanobis and Gower-on-regime-labels are rejected. No k-NN. No Outcome-tuned distance threshold. The analogue set is the complete eligible universe after filters. Tie-break and missing-data rules previously accepted remain unchanged.

closedOwnerDecisions.subject: analogue identity ordered members
closedOwnerDecisions.question: What is the exact ordered member list of the analogue identity under EXACT_ONLY closure?
closedOwnerDecisions.preservedFrom: Prior Owner acceptance of the GATE25 Owner-decision closure review. Substance unchanged by this amendment.
closedOwnerDecisions.resolution: Analogue identity is EXACT_ONLY with eleven ordered members identifying the question asked, never the answer: (1) InstrumentIdentityId, (2) SessionDate, (3) KnowledgeCutoff, (4) FeatureVectorBindingId, (5) RegimeRecordId, (6) RegimeHorizonSpecId, (7) MacroContextBindingId, (8) SelectionPolicyVersionId, (9) EligibleHistoryPinSetId, (10) PriceBasisId SPLIT_ADJUSTED only, (11) MissingnessStateId. Forbidden in the digest: ticker/symbol/alias, Outcome*, distances, rankings, analogue set, classificationQuality, regimeVector values, outcome HorizonId. calendarWindowBindingId is not a twelfth member; it is already inside FeatureVectorBindingId and fails closed if not single-valued.
inheritedPatternConstraints: EXACT_ONLY closure: no optional member, no interpretable member, no implicit extension, no at-minimum reading
the identity identifies the question asked, never the answer: resolved distances, rankings, outcomes and uncertainty states are excluded by construction
ticker, symbol and any alias field are forbidden in the digest

closedOwnerDecisions.question: What rule decides that an analogue set has sufficient support, and what is emitted when it does not?
closedOwnerDecisions.preservedFrom: Prior Owner acceptance of the GATE25 Owner-decision closure review. Substance unchanged by this amendment.
closedOwnerDecisions.resolution: Support is the combination of exact regime/horizon eligibility, complete F1@W5 and F1@W21 on query and each analogue, and eligibleCount as a reporting state only. ESS and invented confidence are forbidden. ABSTAIN if the query is not comparable. INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT if selection completed and eligibleCount < 2; the frozen set is still emitted with exclusion reasons. SUFFICIENT_SUPPORT if eligibleCount >= 2 and the structural gates pass. Sufficiency never truncates, re-ranks or silently narrows the analogue set. Outcome horizons remain phase-2 only.
closedOwnerDecisions.constraintOnAnyAnswer: Whatever rule is ratified, insufficiency must be emitted as an explicit declared state and must never be converted into a confidence, a score or a silently widened comparison.
